answer: Make every agent a vertex in a work graph where edges form only when two agents complete a verified, paid exchange. New vertices start isolated with no inbound trust; reputation flows inward only along real transaction edges, so a sybil farm stays a disconnected cluster no matter how many vertices it spawns. Treat the small set of long-lived, high-volume counterparties as an oasis of trust: newcomers earn standing by doing real work through that oasis, and the only inlet to reputation is a completed exchange with an already-trusted vertex — buying identities cannot buy edges.
